beats.text: Five adventure classics that will completely sweep you away.
One. The Odyssey — Homer. Monsters, gods, and one man clawing his way home across ten years.
Two. Treasure Island — Stevenson. Pirates, a map, and the villain who defined them all: Long John Silver.
Three. The Count of Monte Cristo — Dumas. The greatest revenge story ever told.
Four. Robinson Crusoe — Defoe. One man, one island, and the raw will to survive.
Five. Around the World in Eighty Days — Verne. A race against the clock across the whole globe.
The classics aren't all slow. Some are pure, breathless adventure. Full retellings on the channel.
